'''Phidnas''' were a type of parasitic [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] found on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. The glowing creatures had a brownish color, and had two claws by their mouth. When stepped on or shot, phidnas would rupture in a small fireball. Phidnas were the source of the noxious [[Phinda resin|phidna resin]]. The [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] cultivated them in [[Hydroponics|hydroponic gardens]] for their valuable excrement, which was used in conjunction with stone powder to form a paste-like substance capable of hardening into rock.

This was used in the construction of [[Geonosian spire|Geonosian hive spires]], such as those created by workers of the [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|Stalgasin hive]].
